as_told.title: Travis Walton case with beings working together

plain: In 1975, according to the philosopher Jason Jorjani, a man named Travis Walton, who says he was taken aboard a craft in Arizona, was first held by greys, small grey-skinned beings, until he went "down the hallway" and "bumped into these Nordics," tall human-looking beings who took over from there. Walton himself, in his own words, tells it more simply: while he was trying to find a way out, "a man came in," a "human-looking person," with no mention of a hand-off. Michels also brings up the case briefly as an example of different beings "working together in conjunction."
